data.name: InvalidCode
data.value: Series code must be 2-20 characters and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.

data.name: InvalidNumberSettings
data.value: Number length must be 3-15, and prefix, year and number must not exceed 15 characters in total. Start and next numbers must be positive and increment must be 1-1000.

data.name: DuplicateCode
data.value: This series code is already used for the same branch and document type.

data.name: DuplicateDefault
data.value: Only one active default series is allowed for the same branch and operation type.

data.name: IssuedSeriesImmutable
data.value: The code, operation type and numbering fields of a series that issued numbers cannot be changed. Create a new series.

data.name: IssuedSeriesDeleteBlocked
data.value: A series that issued numbers cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.

data.name: InactiveSeries
data.value: An inactive document series cannot issue a number.

data.name: DocumentTypeMismatch
data.value: The document series does not match the requested operation type.

data.name: NumberAllocationFailed
data.value: The document number could not be allocated atomically.

data.name: SequenceExhausted
data.value: The document series has exhausted its 15-character number capacity. Create a new series.

data.name: ConcurrencyConflict
data.value: The document series was changed by another operation. Refresh and retry.

data.name: Forbidden
data.value: You do not have permission for this operation.
